info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Management API
info.description: The Document Management API facilitates the deletion of specific documents associated with loan applications. Users can target a document by its unique identifier within a given loan application. This API is essential for maintaining document accuracy and compliance by allowing users to remove outdated or incorrect files. Typically utilized by loan officers and financial institutions, the API ensures efficient document management and supports streamlined operations in the loan application process.

delete.summary: Remove a document from a loan application.
delete.description: This API endpoint allows the deletion of a specific document associated with a loan application, identified by its unique resource ID. Make sure you have the necessary permissions to delete this document.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific document associated with a loan application identified by 'RES-100045'. The request expects a JSON payload that outlines the details necessary for processing the deletion.

204.description: The document has been successfully deleted with no additional content returned.

DeleteLoanApplicationDocumentRes100045Re.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a loan application document.
Response schema for the DELETE operation on loan application documents.

correlationId.description: Identifier to correlate the request with the response.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the API response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the loan application request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the operation, allowing tracking of request origins.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses Bearer tokens (in this case, JWT) for authorizing access to secure endpoints.
